name: Nullframe SynthAdapt Civic Day Full Rig
description:
Designed for synthetic body proportions — elongated limb ratios, non-standard torso geometry, and sensor-cluster placement at skull and shoulders. A modular wrap-front overshirt in warm ochre structural jersey closes with magnetic tension bands rather than buttons, draping cleanly over non-human chest geometry. Fluid palazzo trousers in deep indigo with six-panel construction accommodate extended leg ratios. Soft flat-wrap shoes use tension-lace systems for non-standard foot structure.

All panels are fully detachable at standardized clip points for body modification swaps. The shoulder wrap accommodates external sensor arrays without compression.
functionality: Magnetic tension closures eliminate button-incompatible areas, six-panel trouser construction fits extended limb ratios, detachable panel clips for body-mod swaps, sensor-array shoulder accommodation, tension-lace shoes fit non-standard foot geometry.
what_it_says: I exist in this city on my own terms, and I dressed for exactly the body I have.
story_hooks: The magnetic closure system uses a frequency that interferes with certain CorpSec scanner arrays — possibly by design.
Nullframe's pattern-maker is a synthetic who was denied entry to every licensed fashion program in M88; the brand's cult following is quiet but fierce.
A city council proposal to require synthetics to wear identification bands would render this outfit — and everything it represents — illegal overnight.

physical_description.visual_profile: A flowing, asymmetrical silhouette designed for synthetic bodies with elongated proportions. The warm ochre overshirt drapes with architectural precision over non-standard torso geometry, while deep indigo palazzo trousers create a striking two-tone contrast. The overall impression is fluid yet structured—simultaneously soft and engineered.
physical_description.fit: Custom-tailored for synthetic frame proportions: elongated limbs, exaggerated torso depth, sensor mounting points at skull and shoulders. The wrap-front overshirt provides accommodation without compression. Palazzo trousers use six-panel construction for extended leg ratios. Deliberately oversized where humans would be standard.
physical_description.primary_material: Warm ochre structural jersey (overshirt), deep indigo modular synth-cotton blend (trousers), tension-responsive elastane panels at clip points
physical_description.texture: Smooth, engineered finish on the jersey with subtle ribbed seam reinforcement. Trousers have a matte fluid drape with visible panel stitching at modular connection points. Tension-lace shoes feature minimal texture for sensor clarity.
physical_description.color_scheme: Warm ochre (primary overshirt) with deep indigo (trousers and accent bands). Neutral metallic gray at magnetic snap points and clip hardware. No patterns—clean, intentional color blocking.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic tension bands on overshirt (no traditional buttons), six clip-point system for full panel detachment, tension-lace systems on footwear
distinctive_features: Fully modular construction—all panels detach at standardized clip points for body modification swaps
Shoulder wrap designed to accommodate external sensor arrays without compression
Magnetic tension closure system instead of traditional fastening
Six-panel trousers engineered for extended leg ratios
Visible seam reinforcement at all load-bearing joints
Flat-wrap shoe design for non-standard foot geometry
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 4—street-collective functional wear. Affordable for working synthetic bodies, not corpo-grade, but intentionally well-designed rather than salvage.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by synthetic workers, corporate replicant labor, modified humans who've chosen synthetic limbs. Signals street-collective affiliation (Nullframe), embrace of non-human embodiment, and DIY body modification culture. 'Civic Day' branding suggests everyday, public-facing wear for synthetics navigating GLMZ society.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new, but expected to show wear at clip points and magnetic snap edges. Modular panels may be swapped frequently, creating a 'lived-in' customized look over time.
